text: **Hint 1:** Consider the purpose of cross-validation in model evaluation. It is used to assess how the results of a statistical analysis will generalize to an independent data set. Think about whether this process is more or less computationally intensive compared to using a single validation set.\n\n**Hint 2:** Reflect on the advantages of using cross-validation over regular validation. Cross-validation involves partitioning the data into multiple subsets, which allows for more robust evaluation by using different subsets for training and validation. Consider how this might affect the use of the entire dataset and the potential for model bias.
